# Provenance

* `stream.jsonl`: synthetic schema-1.3 trust stream generated by
  `tests/telemetry_formats_reference.rs` (`stream_13`).
* `exposition.prom`, `otlp.json`: written by Kshana from that stream
  (`examples/gen_telemetry_oracle_inputs.rs`).
* `prometheus_reference.json`, `otlp_reference.json`, `collector_reference.json`: what
  prometheus_client 0.26.0 and opentelemetry-proto 1.45.1 (protobuf 7.36.2) read, written by
  `scripts/gen_telemetry_formats_ref.py`.
* `promtool.txt`: output and exit status of promtool 3.5.0 `check metrics` (Prometheus,
  Apache-2.0) on `exposition.prom`.
* `collector_post.txt`, `collector_export.json`: HTTP status and response of, and the file
  exporter's record from, OpenTelemetry Collector contrib 0.135.0 (Apache-2.0) receiving
  `otlp.json`.

The tools are run separately by `xval/telemetry-1.3/run.sh` (release tarballs checked against
pinned SHA-256 digests); none of their code is in Kshana. Only their outputs are stored here.
